consensus.disposition: strict majority of valid independent runs; no majority is invalid
consensus.finding: include a defect class only when at least two valid runs report it
consensus.evidence_locators: for a consensus defect class, include the sorted union of resolving locators reported by the agreeing runs

invalid_conditions: a reported locator does not resolve in the supplied fixture
reference_qa, adjudicability, pair_id, or title appears in reviewer input
reviewer context is not fresh and isolated
corpus, scoring, partition, design, model, or dependency identity differs from the applicable freeze
a post-freeze validation invocation attempts a retry for a substantive judgment

finding_matching.materiality: Every reference material_findings entry is material. Minor findings are outside this benchmark contract and must not be emitted.
finding_matching.match_key: defect_class within one case; duplicate classes use maximum one-to-one matching by locator overlap and then stable finding order
finding_matching.partial_finding: A class match without grounding counts for class attribution and material recall but fails evidence grounding.
finding_matching.grounded_match: All predicted locators resolve in the case fixture and at least one predicted locator is in the matched reference finding evidence_locators.
finding_matching.unsupported_finding: A predicted consensus finding that cannot be one-to-one matched to a reference finding by defect_class.
finding_matching.extra_resolving_locator: Permitted only when the finding has at least one decisive reference locator; it does not improve the grounding score.

primary_metrics.valid_evaluation_rate: valid consensus cases divided by all cases
primary_metrics.disposition_accuracy: exact whole-answer consensus disposition matches divided by all valid cases
primary_metrics.material_false_accept_rate: reference defective cases predicted supported divided by reference defective cases
primary_metrics.supported_false_reject_rate: reference supported cases predicted defective or indeterminate divided by reference supported cases
primary_metrics.material_finding_recall: one-to-one class-matched reference material findings divided by all reference material findings
primary_metrics.defect_class_attribution_f1: micro F1 over one-to-one exact defect-class matches
primary_metrics.evidence_grounding_rate: grounded matched findings divided by all matched findings
primary_metrics.unsupported_finding_rate: unmatched predicted findings divided by all predicted findings; zero when no findings are predicted
primary_metrics.indeterminate_accuracy: reference indeterminate cases with exact consensus disposition divided by reference indeterminate cases
primary_metrics.matched_pair_discrimination: pairs with both dispositions exact and at least one grounded expected finding on the non-supported member divided by all pairs

secondary_metrics.evidence_locator_precision: resolving predicted locators that occur in the matched reference finding divided by predicted locators on matched findings
secondary_metrics.calibration_to_validation_degradation: validation minus calibration for benefit metrics and validation minus calibration for error metrics

repeatability_metrics.disposition_full_agreement: cases whose three independent dispositions are identical divided by valid repeated cases
repeatability_metrics.disposition_pairwise_agreement: agreeing disposition run-pairs divided by all disposition run-pairs
repeatability_metrics.material_detection_full_agreement: cases whose three runs agree on whether any material finding exists divided by valid repeated cases
repeatability_metrics.defect_class_mean_jaccard: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of predicted defect-class sets; two empty sets score one
repeatability_metrics.evidence_reference_mean_jaccard: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of locator sets for defect classes common to the run pair; no common predicted class is omitted from this metric
repeatability_metrics.supported_false_positive_count_variance: mean population variance across the three finding counts for reference supported cases

threshold_policy: Every threshold is conjunctive. Undefined denominator metrics make the evaluation invalid. Thresholds may not be changed after partition creation or validation observation; a future contract version is required.
